title: Camden National Corporation to Announce Quarter and Year Ended December 31, 2025 Financial Results on January 27, 2026
summary: Camden National Corporation (NASDAQ: CAC) will report financial and operating results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2025 on Tuesday, January 27, 2026. A conference call and webcast will be held at 3:00 p.m. Eastern on Tuesday, January 27, 2026, hosted by Simon Griffiths, President and Chief Executive Officer, Michael Archer, Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Renée Smyth, Executive Vice President, Chief Experience and Marketing Officer. Parties interested in listening to the teleconference should dial into the call or connect to the webcast link 10 – 15 minutes before it begins. Dial-in and webcast information to participate is as follows: Live Dial-In (Domestic): (833) 470-1428 Link to Obtain Live Dial-In (International): https://www.netroadshow.com/events/global-numbers?confId=93678 Participant Access Code: 070467 Live Webcast URL: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/950792469 A link to the live webcast will be available on Camden
